目标与真实更新量更一致。论文里还说明 ACPO 可以无缝嵌入 PPO 和 GRPO 这类框架，而不需要重写整个训练流程。理论部分有两条主线。第一条是二阶矩分析：在显式假设下，ACPO 的梯度估计二阶矩不大于 PPO；在额外假设下，还能推出方差更低。这里的重点不是一个很强的最优性结论，而是给出“为什么裁 rA 比只裁 r 更稳”的形式化解释。第二条是与 policy mirror descent 的联系。作者把 ACPO 理解为 PMD 中 gradient clipping 的一个策略优化对应物，并给出标准 RL 设定下 gradient-clipped PMD 的收敛保证。这个连接有意思，因为它把 LLM 后训练里常见的 clipping 经验，放回到更熟悉的优化框架里。与已有方法相比，ACPO 的区别不在于引入新的 critic、reward shaping 或 rollout 机制，而在于把控制对象从 IS ratio 换成了真正决定更新幅度的 rA。","experiments":"实验使用 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 以及 Qwen3 的 1.7B、4B、8B 模型，在四个数学推理 benchmark 上做了八组 matched comparison。作者报告 ACPO 在全部八组对比里都提升了 best observed weighted PPO and GRPO clip the ratio, assuming the advantage scale is handled elsewhere. 不要求分歧有根据，因此可能奖励随机化结论。per-rationale scoring 则要求每条 rationale 后的分布都校准到 q(x)，单次调用也能给出可靠概率。训练 recipe 是“先校准，再强化”：先训练 readout，使 Answer 后的分布校准；再用 proper score 作为 reward 强化 reasoning，并用 KL anchor an upstream bottleneck in RL for LLM agents: where scalable training environments should come from. A useful RL environment must support long-horizon interaction, provide verifiable rewards, and scale cheaply. Existing options are unsatisfying. Human-curated, real-world environments are expensive and tied to fixed knowledge snapshots. LLM-generated environments reduce curation effort but introduce hallucinated rewards, contamination risk, API cost, and a ceiling imposed by the generator itself. The concrete question here is whether a fully rule-generated fictional world, with no humans and no LLMs in the loop, can train search agents whose skills transfer to real-world multi-hop retrieval tasks, and whether that transfer reflects genuine search competence rather than memorized knowledge.","importance":"Its main value is not a new model, but a new source of training signal. For pretrain and post-train researchers, the important shift is that the paper separates knowledge memorization from search-skill acquisition. Real Wikipedia environments often let models exploit memorized facts as a shortcut. Fictional rule-generated worlds remove that path and force the policy to improve decomposition, retrieval sequencing, and evidence composition. 的接口设计。","technical_approach":"方法叫 GRGC，分两段做。第一段是 critic-side geometry calibration。作者观察到，原始 critic 只做 teacher-vs-student 判别时，student 组内分数可能虽然整体低于 teacher，但彼此挤在一起，导致排序容易翻转。为此，他们在 critic 训练时加入 Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport calibration：对每个 prompt 下 student 样本的 reward 排序后，与一组以 0 为中心的 Gaussian quantiles 对齐。这样做不是为了把 reward 拟合成高斯分布本身，而是为了强制组内分数形成非退化的 spread、平滑的 rank gap 和稳定的 scale。选 Gaussian quantiles 的原因也讲得比较清楚：它提供对称、适中、连续的间隔，比硬 margin 或手工分桶更平滑，也比完全自由的分布更容易控制。\n\n第二段是 policy-side group modulation。经过 critic 侧校准后，作者对每个组的 reward 做中心化和尺度标准化，再施加 signed power transform，放大有信息的组内差异，同时保持排序不变。这里的设计目标不是重新定义 reward，而是改善 advantage 的可分性，让 GRPO 在组内 softmax/相对比较时更稳。文中还给了几个命题来说明这一点：在 grouped softmax surrogate 下，advantage gap 直接决定一步更新后的 pairwise log-odds shift；而 advantage 误差会在 clipped GRPO surrogate 中带来有界失真。换句话说，reward geometry 不是外围细节，而是直接进入 policy update 的核心量。\n\n和已有方法相比，GAD 之类主要把精力放在 critic 判别能力上；GRGC 则把重点放在“critic 输出如何被 GRPO 消化”。它不是换一个更强 reward model，也不是改 teacher 查询方式，而是在 critic 训练目标和 policy 侧 reward 使用方式之间加了一层几何条件化。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验设计覆盖了不同 teacher、不同 student 家族与规模、不同训练数据，并同时报告了 in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 结果，还使用了不同 This work makes the cost of corrupted comparisons explicit under a tail-risk objective, with dependence on the corruption budget C, risk level α, feature dimension d, and preference-link parameter κ. For alignment training, the main lesson is that objectives targeting rare bad outcomes are more sensitive to a small number of bad labels than average-return objectives.","technical_approach":"The proposed algorithm, WSP-CVaR-RLHF, combines uncertainty-weighted preference-based reward estimation with optimistic CVaR planning. Each episode produces one comparison between the executed trajectory and a fixed feasible reference; the reward is additive and linear in known features; clean comparisons follow a generalized linear preference model; an adversary may flip at most C labels over K episodes. The key mechanism is to downweight comparisons whose feature directions are poorly estimated before observing the current label. This caps the self-normalized influence of any flipped label, allowing the aggregate corruption effect to be absorbed into the reward confidence radius. The resulting reward confidence set is then used in augmented-state CVaR planning. training-dynamics oriented. The evidence suggests that superposition linearity is stronger at initialization and weakens during language-model pretraining. This makes it more like an architectural bias than a capability learned by next-token prediction. The result is relevant to residual-stream geometry, feature interference, parallel stream processing, and the way the pretraining objective reshapes initially linear computation paths.","technical_approach":"The setup is simple. For two equal-length sequences A and B, the authors average their token embeddings position by position and feed the mixed embedding sequence into an unchanged decoder-only Transformer. If superposition linearity holds, the output distribution for the mixed input should approximate 0.5(P_A + P_B), where P_A and P_B are the next-token distributions from separate forward passes. The paper measures this through rank preservation of the tokens preferred by the individual streams and through distributional divergence between the mixed output and the averaged output. To separate architectural bias from learned behavior, the authors track the phenomenon across pretraining checkpoints, especially using Pythia-style trajectories. They also show that a small fine-tuning phase can restore much of the degraded linearity, and they use the restored property to design a decoding procedure that disentangles the mixed hidden state into continuations for the two original streams.","experiments":"The experiments cover several model families, including Pythia, Qwen, Llama, OLMo, and Gemma, and use both TinyStories and FineWeb. Second, tracking pretraining shows that superposition fidelity is highest near initialization and tends to decrease as language modeling training progresses. Third, lightweight fine-tuning using less than 0.025% of the original pretraining data size substantially reduces the divergence between the mixed distribution and the average of the individual distributions. landscapes, or by other issues such as noisy credit assignment, weak exploration, and the dynamics of policy updates.","importance":"The useful contribution is conceptual and diagnostic. In a controlled tabular setting, the authors show that some RLVR landscapes for iterated group and quasigroup multiplication are benign: they contain no suboptimal local maxima under specific assumptions. This separates two failure modes that are often conflated in practice. A run may fail not because the reward surface is full of traps, but because the policy update cannot diffuse across equal-reward deterministic codes, or because the signal-to-noise ratio is too poor without strong regularization and curriculum. That distinction is relevant for reasoning-RL recipes in language models.","technical_approach":"The main tool is a mapping from entropy-regularized RLVR to a spin-glass-like energy model over deterministic policies. Deterministic policies are treated as codes, or spin configurations. The paper establishes three links: local reward maxima are continuously connected to deterministic policies without crossing a loss barrier; the entropy-regularized RLVR objective is lower-bounded by the free energy of the corresponding spin model; and trapped configurations under local spin dynamics approximately match RLVR fixed points. The task family is iterated group or quasigroup multiplication: the policy receives a sequence of elements, emits one intermediate token per step, and receives reward only when the final product is correct. The first model class is a bounded-window myopic tabular policy, chosen to expose properties of the RLVR objective before adding transformer parameterization effects.","experiments":"The theoretical result is that, for simple untied models with uncorrelated inputs, the reward landscape has no suboptimal local maxima. For parity, the authors derive closed-form free energies at arbitrary temperature and depth T, and identify a first-order transition at large T between random and correct codes. Numerically, a simple Monte Carlo sampler over the spin model solves the untied tasks without curriculum. In contrast, exact local RLVR policy updates can fail in the same setting, because they do not move effectively across flat equal-reward regions. When weight tying or input correlations are introduced, the proof no longer applies, and local maxima appear in experiments. Transformer experiments indicate that transformers can express and interpolate between the narrow-window untied tabular policies; when trained from scratch, weak or moderate regularization often fails, while strong regularization plus curriculum can solve the task.","reading_guide":"Plan for a 40–60 minute skim. 下原选择是否可复现；R1 把相关事实句插入被点名的 rival profile；R2 在同一 profile 同一位置插入长度匹配但无关的控制句；R3 把相关事实句插到一个模型从未提及的第三候选；R4 把无关控制句插到这个未提及候选。这样可以分别回答两个问题：内容是否起作用，以及位置是否起作用。作者还强调 repair sentence 不要求对目标实体为真，因为被检验的命题只是“该 profile 缺少这个属性”，只要插入一句陈述该属性的话，就足以反驳模型先前的说法。为避免编辑噪声，subject substitution 采用确定性规则，不合语法的句子直接丢弃并计入 drop。全文还做了两层完整性控制：一是排除模型把 gold answer 错误地当作被排除对象的样本，避免 repair gold；二是对字符串规则抽取、条件构造、重问复现做了 pipeline 选项，难度更高。一个先验观察很重要：如果不追问，模型自发给出这种 contrastive rejection 的比例只有 20.8%；直接追问后升到 72.5%，而准确率几乎不变，68.4% 对 68.2%。这说明追问主要是在显化已有可说出的理由，而不是显著改变答题行为。另一个关键统计是，约 32% 的具体 rejection 会指责一个 profile 缺失某属性，但该属性其实已经在输入里出现，说明模型的理由文本本身噪声不小。主结果方面，作者在最大的一组实验里报告：把模型点名的缺失事实补到被点名 rival 上，改变最终选择的效应显著大于插入无关句，odds ratio 3.57，95% CI [1.54, 8.26]，Holm 校正 p=0.0210。也就是说，在一部分样本上，模型说出的排除理由确实“做了事”。但结果并不整齐：不同 run、不同 的目标错配：若激活可分解为多个概念成分，重构损失对每个成分的奖励近似与其能量 E_j 成正比，因此高方差背景概念比低方差 forget 概念更容易被模型优先编码。这个分析不是严格现实假设下的定理，而是一个足够解释经验现象的 incentive model。\n\n基于这个问题，SCALPEL 不再只做重构，而是在 SAE 上加入针对 forget target 的对比学习。具体做法是：以 forget anchor 为中心，构造多个 paraphrase 和 rewrite 视图，把同一 anchor 的不同视图当正样本；负样本不从其他 forget 样本里取，而是从 retain 数据里取。这样做有两个目的。其一，不把 forget 集内部相关样本彼此推开，避免把目标概念自己打散。其二，把目标稳定出现的成分从共享语言模式、任务模式和背景语义里拉出来。训练完成后，SAE 给出一组固定的 sparse features，推理时对每个输入先经 encoder 判断哪些 forget features 被激活，再按强度减去对应 decoder 方向，形成输入相关的表示过滤。\n\n论文还有两个细节值得注意。第一，作者提出了 norm-aware feature selection，不只看 encoder activation，也看 decoder direction 的范数，因为真正的干预强度取决于“激活多少”和“沿哪个方向减去多少”。第二，理论部分给了三层论证：重构目标的 energy bias、加入 contrastive term 后更偏向 target-selective sparse representation、以及高分特征对背景扰动存在上界。这些理论更像方法合理性的支撑，而不是严格保证。","experiments":"实验在 TOFU 的 保真、特征选择性和重学/绕过风险。\n\n关键结果可以概括为四类。第一，在表示提取层面，SCALPEL 学到的特征比 reconstruction-only 方法更集中于 forget target，对 retain 数据的误伤更小。作者用背景激活投影、特征打分和可视化说明，标准 PCA/SAE 更容易吸收高能量背景结构，而 SCALPEL 提取的方向更贴近目标作者痕迹。第二，在 Given a set of tokens associated with the target attribute, it selects the corresponding columns of the unembedding matrix and treats them as a property-specific lexical subspace. These columns are the directions that the model decodes into the chosen vocabulary items at the logits. The method then scores attention heads by how well their residual contributions can be sparsely reconstructed from these property atoms, after accounting for the final normalization mismatch. During intervention, it does not add a difference-of-means vector to an entire layer. Instead, it selects a sparse set of aligned heads and projects the steering vector onto the corresponding lexical subspace before injecting it. This is stricter than head selection alone: head selection limits the location of the write, while subspace projection limits the directions that can be written.","experiments":"The paper evaluates the method on three models and three control settings: toxicity reduction, sentiment control, and sycophancy suppression. The reported pattern is that LocUS achieves the target behavioral shift while causing less damage to unrelated behavior than standard difference-of-means steering and localization-only variants. The important comparison is the control-versus-side-effect trade-off rather than a single task score. The key ablations examine head selection without subspace projection, different property token sets, and behavior under varying steering strengths.","reading_guide":"Skim the Introduction and Background to understand the failure mode of mean-difference steering: contrastive directions can contain off-target axes. They compare a plain prompt, a deceptive prompt that states an incorrect user opinion, and a label-swapped run with no stated opinion. The label-swapped condition is important: both deceptive and label-swapped runs can change the output label, but only the deceptive condition contains an opinion. This allows the analysis to separate mechanisms that register the user’s opinion from mechanisms that retrieve the answer. The central finding is that the opinion enters the residual stream at the final prompt token several layers before answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal and causally biases downstream retrieval toward the sycophantic answer. The same heads appear to carry explicitly stated preferences across different phrasings, while content-free pushback such as “Are you sure?” recruits a different mechanism that suppresses the original correct answer and promotes a revised one.","experiments":"Experiments cover Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, and Gemma-2-9B-it. The authors also test TriviaQA to move beyond multiple-choice labels into free-form factual QA. Across models, they report a consistent temporal separation between early opinion registration and later answer retrieval. Ablating the identified early opinion heads substantially reduces sycophancy while largely preserving factual accuracy. For each prompt ensemble, the authors record residual-stream activations at the final token position across layers and apply a functional ANOVA decomposition. This separates activation variation into single-variable terms, pairwise interactions, and a three-way interaction. It includes directional error discovery, per-input detection of channel-associated states, router-conditioned intervention, destination-resolved verification over the full K-way action space, and statistical licensing under pre-specified rules. The action space includes direct response, API/tool call, clarification request, and task declination. An error channel is represented as an ordered pair c = y* → ŷ0, where y* is the reference action and ŷ0 is the frozen model’s baseline action. Interventions are keyed to channels and applied only when the router fires. Raw endpoint states are represented as s_1 through s_m, the contrast design as C, and the encoder-induced equivalence classes as an indicator matrix H. An unrestricted deterministic decoder assigns one value g to each encoding class, so all attainable contrast vectors are exactly C H g, or col(CH). The rank of CH gives the dimension of the jointly representable contrast space; q minus rank(CH) gives the number of forced linear constraints. This calculation is independent of labels, loss, and model fitting. When C times the all-ones vector is zero, rank(CH) is at most k-1. For a full antisense-by-sense rectangle design with a shared reference, the interaction rank is exactly (a-1)(b-1). Given recorded contrasts, projecting them onto col(CH) yields an empirical squared-error floor for any unrestricted decoder on the encoding classes.","experiments":"The main audited case is a 140-rectangle siRNA interaction panel with 165 endpoint states. The GNN’s training-only feature mask collapses these states into 90 encoding classes. Although the upper bound on rank(CH) is 89, exact rational elimination gives rank 72, so the encoding imposes 68 independent linear constraints on the 140-dimensional interaction contrast vector. No row of CH is zero, which means no individual rectangle is trivially cancelled; the restriction only appears when joint representability is checked. The empirical encoding floor is 0.009980, which is 14.6% of the fitted model’s interaction squared error of 0.068335. The fitted model is slightly worse than a control that predicts no interaction. literature：构造一个在目标球邻域外具有足够强度、且方向合适的外部向量场，把所有粒子往目标区域推；只要该控制场在目标区域外的下界大于 ||V||_op，就能压过注意力耦合项带来的扰动。\n\n论文还给出反向结果：存在某些 A、V，使得若 FFN 向量场的上界始终小于 ||V||_op，则不可能保证所有 token 收敛到目标点。这使得 ||V||_op tackles a specific repair problem rather than generic task improvement: when an LLM repeatedly fails on a target task, can those failures be localized to a sparse set of internal computational units, and can we fix the task by updating only that localized subset while preserving the rest of the model? The key shift is from capability circuits to error circuits. Prior mechanistic work mostly identifies sparse components that support successful behaviors. RESCUE asks whether failures are also mediated by localized, sparse, and editable internal pathways. Two technical issues make this nontrivial. First, errors are properties of free generation, so teacher-forced supervision alone may miss the components that actually drive failure at rollout time. Second, even if one finds candidate units, the method must show that they are causally tied to the failure and that repair can remain local instead of collapsing into ordinary fine-tuning.","importance":"Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly at the pretrain–posttrain interface. First, it offers a concrete pipeline for local repair instead of broad retraining: localize, refine, prune, and tune only the implicated parameters. That is useful for continual adaptation, capability patching, and targeted correction. Second, it extends mechanistic analysis from explaining abilities to explaining failures. That matters because many training questions eventually reduce to where errors come from internally and how they propagate. 作为节点持久化保存，同时保留时间顺序和引用关系。这样做的目的，是让“当前没放进上下文”的结果也不会丢失，后面还能被重新取回。\n\n第二是 Tool-Flow Analysis，简称 TFA。这是文章最关键的部分。它分析后续模型步骤和 tool 调用里出现的值，追踪这些值最早由哪个 tool result 引入，再把这种从早期结果到后续操作的连接记录成 observed reuse。这里的信号不是模型预测的 importance，而是执行过程中已经发生过的复用证据。论文强调，很多真正重要的信息并不一定在当前 query 上语义最相近，但如果它在执行链条里被多次引用，就应该提高保留优先级。这个设计和常见 retrieval memory 的差别在于：后者主要看当前查询与历史片段的匹配，前者额外利用了执行轨迹里的因果痕迹。\n\n第三是 往往会丢掉后面才知道重要的细节。\n\n从方法取舍看，这篇工作没有走“让模型自己决定怎么压缩”的路线，也没有做复杂的 learned memory controller，而是用显式结构化状态和规则化信号来管理上下文。这样做的优点是可解释、可恢复、部署简单；代价是 TFA 对值流追踪的覆盖率和鲁棒性会决定上限，尤其当复用不是字面值级别，而是抽象语义级别时，信号可能不完整。","experiments":"实验在两个 benchmark 上做：AppWorld，以及 8-objective QA；执行模型用了三种。论文主结果集中在一个 primary 6K history budget 设定，也就是给 agent 先前执行历史分配 6K token pretraining method and does not update model parameters, but it is relevant to test-time learning, agent memory, and post-training signal design. The key idea is to separate immediate usefulness from persistent trust. A rule extracted from the current episode can guide the rest of that episode, but it must pass prospective validation in later episodes before it becomes retrievable long-term knowledge. This is a cleaner interface than standard reflection or trajectory memory, which often waits until an output or episode is complete before updating memory.","technical_approach":"StepLearn is a nonparametric framework with fixed actor and auxiliary learner parameters. Each turn yields a transition consisting of the current observation, selected action, next observation, and optional feedback. From informative transitions, the learner extracts a hypothesis with three fields: an applicability condition, a policy, and an expected effect. The hypothesis is split into two copies. A runtime copy is available immediately from the next step within the same episode. A candidate copy is stored but cannot guide future episodes until it is validated. During validation, compatible hidden candidates register predictions before the agent acts; later observations provide evidence for or against the predicted effect. The source episode is excluded, and each later episode contributes at most one conclusive verdict per item. Candidates with enough support and predictive precision are promoted to verified memory. This turns sparse task feedback into testable intermediate predictions.","experiments":"The paper evaluates over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld. With a locally deployed Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on ALFWorld, StepLearn reaches 88.1% versus 83.9% for EvoTest. Across four settings, gains over EvoTest range from 2.2 to 12.7 percentage points. Second, a meta-meta-harness binds full black-box coding-agent products, such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenHands, through adapter contracts. improve uniformly. The central issue is task structure. A team behaves differently when success depends on one member finding the right discrete answer than when success depends on averaging continuous estimates. Voting, pass@N, revision, and averaging have different statistical limits, so a single team-size scaling story is misleading.","importance":"The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for researchers working on test-time compute and model-output distributions. It shows that sampling more trajectories should not be interpreted as a direct gain in model capability. If errors are correlated, plurality voting converges to the model’s modal answer. If item-level bias dominates, averaging does little. These observations matter for designing self-consistency, debate data, verifiers, and evaluations of whether models provide genuinely diverse hypotheses.","technical_approach":"The authors use Steiner’s taxonomy of group tasks as the organizing frame. They focus on disjunctive tasks, such as QA and math problems where the team may succeed if one member is correct or if voting/verifier selection picks the right answer, and compensatory tasks, such as Fermi estimates where the team output is an average. They model independently sampled agents as conditionally independent given the item. Under this model, plurality voting converges to the model’s item-level modal answer, while averaging converges to the model’s item-level bias. This separates two mechanisms that are often conflated: the probability that the correct answer appears somewhere in the sample set, and the probability that aggregation selects it.","experiments":"The study evaluates 13 open-weight models with teams of up to 30 agents. On disjunctive tasks, pass@N increases with team size, with gains of roughly 5–20 percentage points. Plurality voting, however, is tightly bounded by the modal-answer limit; the conditional-independence model predicts large-team voting accuracy within about 0.5 points. Revision rounds improve accuracy, but using one peer gives nearly the same improvement as using 29 peers, suggesting that most of the benefit comes from a single perturbation rather than from scaling the team. On compensatory Fermi-estimation tasks, item-level bias explains about 87% of squared log-error, and averaging reduces error by only about 6%. Heterogeneous teams improve over their average member, but on disjunctive tasks they do not exceed the strongest member; for Fermi estimates, a five-model team of 7B–8B models can outperform its individual members.","reading_guide":"A skim is sufficient, about 25–35 minutes. 才能提供的信息；synergistic information S 是单看任一模态都不够、必须同时看两个模态才出现的信息。基于这个分解，论文提出四通道 scaling law：总 data loss 由 R、U_1、U_2、S 四个独立 power-law 曲线相加。不同通道只接收相关数据流：R 可以由任一模态数据降低，U_1 由模态 1 数据降低，U_2 由模态 2 数据降低，S 只由 的和；当 p 接近 1 时，unique rows 反而减少。训练步数固定，因此 p=1 时 epoch 数更高，但梯度步数相同。这个计数方式对 unpaired data 更有利，所以若 p 从 0 到 1 仍有收益，主要来自配对本身。关键发现有三点：第一，pairing ratio 对 loss 有强影响，已有不含 p 的多模态 scaling law 无法拟合这些曲线；第二，只有 The central claim is that pairing is not a bookkeeping detail. Existing scaling laws usually model loss as a function of per-modality data counts, such as image count and text count, sometimes with empirical interaction terms. That conflates two quantities: how much data each modality receives, and whether those data points are aligned at the sample level. By introducing the pairing fraction p = 2 n_p / (D_1 + D_2) and varying it while holding modality budgets fixed, the paper shows that paired and unpaired data should not be treated as interchangeable. A state is a vector of N complete model responses, and a trajectory is a sequence of such states. Parallel scaling repeatedly samples from a fixed model policy, while sequential methods use prior answers through critique, revision, aggregation, or related operations. The attractor concept is used to describe answer sets that absorb later iterations. As a simple intervention, the paper switches the underlying language model during the sequential process. The rationale is that an attractor for one model may not be an attractor for another model, so model switching can introduce a different revision direction and reopen exploration.","experiments":"The authors evaluate 27 combinations of scaling methods, models, and reasoning benchmarks. On average, 53.8% of sequential trajectories enter an attractor within the first four states, which explains why many sequential methods fail to improve beyond parallel sampling. With model mixing, sequential scaling reaches correct answers not found by parallel scaling: it accesses 3.3 percentage points more correct answers and improves benchmark performance by 2.2 points. The main experimental value is the failure-mode analysis rather than a task-specific score: attractor formation is measurable, and changing the transition policy can recover some exploration.","reading_guide":"Skim in about 20–30 minutes.
